title: How to bounce your canon permutation
summary: We study a new class of palindromic descent polynomials. Given a Dyck path $d$ of semilength $n$ and a permutation $σ$ of size $n$, one can label the up-steps and down-steps of $d$ with the elements of $σ$. The labeled Dyck path determines a multiset permutation called a canon (or nonnesting) permutation. Such permutations arise as linear extensions of posets and as regions of hyperplane arrangements.
